scenes.caption: A road.
scenes.say: Imran walks along a straight Roman road near Bath.

scenes.caption: Stones.
scenes.say: The road has layers of stone and gravel.

scenes.caption: A forum.
scenes.say: In the town he finds the forum, a market square.

scenes.caption: Baths.
scenes.say: Next he finds the hot baths where Romans met friends.

scenes.caption: A mosaic.
scenes.say: A mosaic floor is made of tiny stone pieces.

scenes.caption: A mix.
scenes.say: He learns that Britons and Romans mixed their ways.

scenes.caption: A museum.
scenes.say: Imran visits the museum to learn more.

scenes.caption: Heritage.
scenes.say: Imran wants to protect this heritage for everyone.
